MIDFIELD_CONTROL.name: Midfield control
MIDFIELD_CONTROL.objective: Win the centre of the pitch and keep the ball.
MIDFIELD_CONTROL.favorable: Central midfielders with strong mentality and attack.
MIDFIELD_CONTROL.advantages: Midfield improves with the quality of your midfielders.
MIDFIELD_CONTROL.risks: Slower progression (less attack). Loses force against compact blocks and high pressing.

WIDE_PLAY.name: Wide play
WIDE_PLAY.objective: Stretch the opponent and attack the flanks.
WIDE_PLAY.favorable: Wingers and attacking full-backs against weaker opposing full-backs.
WIDE_PLAY.advantages: Attack improves with your wingers; deep blocks concede the flanks.
WIDE_PLAY.risks: Fewer players centrally and advanced full-backs.

COUNTER_ATTACK.name: Counter-attack
COUNTER_ATTACK.objective: Absorb pressure and attack the space the opponent leaves.
COUNTER_ATTACK.favorable: Fast forwards against teams that leave space.
COUNTER_ATTACK.advantages: Attack improves with your forwards and the opponent's space; solid central defence.
COUNTER_ATTACK.risks: You cede the midfield. Barely works against teams that leave no space.

HIGH_PRESS.name: High press
HIGH_PRESS.objective: Win the ball high up the pitch.
HIGH_PRESS.favorable: Physically strong midfielders and forwards against teams that build slowly.
HIGH_PRESS.advantages: Midfield and attack improve with physique; weaker against a secure build-up.
HIGH_PRESS.risks: Leaves space behind the defence; the effect fades for low-stamina squads.

LOW_BLOCK.name: Low block
LOW_BLOCK.objective: Protect the middle zones and concede territory.
LOW_BLOCK.favorable: Solid centre-backs, defensive midfielder and goalkeeper.
LOW_BLOCK.advantages: Defence improves with your centre-backs; leaves no space behind.
LOW_BLOCK.risks: Less attack and midfield. Weaker against teams attacking wide.

goal.title: Build your eleven
goal.body: Choose CPU, online or two players. Then choose your collection.

auction.title: How the auction works
auction.body: Bid or pass to complete your eleven within budget.

budget.title: Budget and slots
budget.body: Each team has a budget and slots per position: ARQ, DEF, MED and DEL. The panel shows the maximum safe bid: up to that amount you will still have enough money to complete your team. The discard counter is at the top.

lineup.title: Arrange your team
lineup.body: Once the teams are complete you can swap footballers within the same line and confirm your order. If you enabled substitutes, they wait on the bench.

match.title: Strategy and match
match.body: Before the match each team picks a strategy. In two-person mode, recruiter one picks first, the device is handed over and then recruiter two picks. Then the match starts and you can follow the key events. The team with the better global average gets a small extra bonus, and a good strategy adds on top.

tips.label: Help
tips.setup: Choose your rival and rules. The classic setup is enough to start.
tips.coin: Pick heads or tails: it decides who opens the first auction.
tips.reveal: Check the footballer's position, rating and base price. When you are ready, start the auction.
tips.bidding: Bid from the base price or pass. The safe maximum keeps you from running out of budget to complete your team.
tips.result: The new signing already shows on the pitch. Continue to the next round.
tips.teams: Arrange your eleven, confirm it and pick a strategy before playing the match.
tips.freeDraft: Free Draft: pick a footballer for every slot without going over budget, then confirm your eleven to play the CPU.
tips.match: The match unfolds in stages. Follow the key events and, at the end, read the summary and ask for a rematch.

collections.legendBudget: 200M per team for legends, 4-3-3 and eleven starters. This budget preserves the supplied ratings.
collections.notice: Editorial collections: Every league offers its first 150 editorial positions per edition (Italy keeps 200 in its source but plays with the first 150). No new photos. Historical editions represent careers, including active players. Ratings adapted to the game scale.

series.title: Same squad · three-match series
series.help: Play all three matches with the same players, substitutes, coach and strategy. Most wins takes the series; draws add no wins. If tied, play two more matches. If still level, penalties decide. Each match uses a new seed; replay keeps its result.

categoryTree.editionHelp: Current: 2026 version. Legends: historical career version; some players may still be active outside that league.

playtest.avatar: Illustration of {{name}} wearing reference club colours
playtest.formationHelp: Only shapes supported by your players are enabled. Buy substitutes to add defenders or midfielders. Choosing a shape reorganizes the eleven by position and rating; you can then adjust it.
playtest.manualBench: Substitutes do not enter automatically. Use Replace to change one or more starters before confirming. Only your chosen eleven plays.
playtest.seriesHelp: Play two games with the same squad and decisions. Most wins takes the series; draws add no wins. Equal wins trigger a third game, then penalties if still tied. No away goals or home advantage apply.
playtest.seriesProgress: You completed {{played}} game(s). Game {{next}} is next, with the same team.
playtest.explain: Effective strength: {{local}} vs {{cpu}}. Tier bonus: {{localQuality}} vs {{cpuQuality}}. Coaches: {{localCoach}} vs {{cpuCoach}}. Formations: {{localFormation}} vs {{cpuFormation}}. Tactics: {{localTactic}} vs {{cpuTactic}}. These choices shaped the opportunities alongside randomness. An advantage improves the probability without guaranteeing the result.
playtest.adjustments: Mean tactical adjustments (attack / defense / midfield): {{local}} vs {{cpu}}. Formation affinity is included.
playtest.mixedHelp: Different categories run two live, independent draws on one screen: each team sees its own players one by one and signs or discards them at base price, with no shared auction. Each team uses its own category of players and coaches. Both have the same budget.

squad.title: Your squad is complete!
squad.body: First choose one of three coaches or continue without one. With money left, you can buy up to three substitutes: players both recruiters passed on appear first, with other catalogue players completing the offer. Substitutes are optional: exchange them with starters if you wish. Then choose a formation and confirm your eleven.

strategy.title: Choose how to play
strategy.body: Once your eleven is confirmed, choose a tactic. Read its strengths and costs: none always wins. Both opponents choose privately; confirming closes the squad for the series.

ready.title: Time for the match!
ready.body: Both teams are ready. Start the match and follow the action. A return leg follows with the same eleven, coach and tactic. New game lets you change categories; rematch keeps the categories.

playtest.probabilities: Using mean effective strengths: attack share {{attackLocal}}% / {{attackCpu}}%; finishing per shot on target {{finishLocal}}% / {{finishCpu}}%. These are play probabilities, not match-win odds. Outfield S+ players add 1.2 percentage points of finishing each, up to 3.6. S+ cards appear less often in the draw.
playtest.poolHelp: Collection size follows eligible identities, without a 300-player cap. Draws select match cards while preserving position quotas, exclusivity and budget. S+ retains its reduced draw weight.
playtest.tableNote: Affinities are game rules. Quality, opposition and randomness also matter. The 4-2-3-1 uses two DEL wingers and one MED attacking midfielder; it does not require converting forwards into midfielders. A 4-5-1 requires five MED players: you can buy two midfield substitutes.
playtest.marketLeft: You have {{amount}}M left. Buy up to three outfield substitutes, including several from the same line.

liveDT.keepWarning: Every remaining block will be played. At each pending window, both teams will keep their strategy and lineup (KEEP), including the CPU. moments.label: Defence: your decision
moments.attributes: Options use overall, attack, defence, physical and mental ratings, together with effective team strength. Neither guarantees success.

aerial.title: You won it in the air! Where do you head it?
aerial.label: Header: choose direction
aerial.detailHint: Near post: balanced accuracy and difficulty. Centre: more accurate, easier for the keeper. Far post: less accurate, harder to save. The keeper’s initial reaction is fixed before your choice. Ratings and effective strength affect the chances; no direction guarantees a goal.

halftime.title: HALF-TIME
halftime.question: Keep your approach or change strategy?
halftime.keep: Keep strategy and start second half
halftime.subQueued: Change requested for the next break. Press the same button to cancel.
halftime.duels: Direct duels use OVR: equal ratings mean equal chances. Passing, accuracy and finishing keep their own attributes. A failed press leaves more space.

corner.attack: How do you take the corner?
corner.label: Corner: your decision
corner.detail: Man marking: individual OVR duel, starting at 50/50 for equal ratings. P(defender) = 1 / (1 + exp(−0.08 × OVR difference)), bounded to 5–95%. Zonal defence: DEF/MEN coverage against the taker; stronger against short corners, more exposed at the far post. Failed coverage leaves the target free. Delivery, accuracy and saves keep their own calculations; nothing is guaranteed.
corner.keepWarning: Simulate the rest without further questions. Both teams keep their strategy and eleven at remaining breaks. Attack: best available wing receiver, then shoot; defence: intercept. Corners: near post in attack, man marking in defence, then head towards the goal centre. Continue?

hint.CORNER_NEAR: Safer delivery towards the near post
hint.CORNER_FAR: Find the target at the far post
hint.CORNER_SHORT: Short pass and a brief continuation
hint.MAN_MARK: Challenge the target in an individual duel

freeKick.cover: How will you cover the delivery?
freeKick.label: Interactive free kick
freeKick.detail: Zones are approximate: central outside the box allows a direct shot; wide or deep allows a cross or short pass. ATT and MEN estimate accuracy, PHY power, DEF and MEN coverage. Individual duels use OVR; coach, strategy and formation already contribute to effective strength. No option guarantees an outcome.
freeKick.keepWarning: Free kicks will use the first available target, cross or man marking and a jumping wall; no further tactical questions. Continue?

hint.FK_CROSS: Find the forward in the box.
hint.FK_SHORT: One pass and a brief continuation.

hint.WALL_HOLD: The wall keeps its low coverage.
